name: xquad
description: Trabalhe com os quadros do Xquad conversando: inicie, conclua e crie cards e veja o status do quadro. Login pelo Xquad, sem token.

interface.longDescription: Trabalhe com os quadros do Xquad conversando. Inicie um card e ele vai para a coluna de desenvolvimento, com o cronômetro contando; conclua com um comentário do que mudou e como testar; crie cards seguindo as etiquetas do espaço; veja o que está em andamento, em teste e pronto; e anexe prints e arquivos do computador. Feito para times que usam o Xquad para organizar o trabalho. O login é pelo próprio Xquad (sem token), e o agente só vê e altera o que você pode ver e alterar na tela. Não cria espaços de outras pessoas nem acessa espaços em que você não está.
defaultPrompt: Como está o quadro do meu espaço no Xquad?
Cria um card no Xquad para este bug

positive.prompt: How is the board of my DEMO space in Xquad?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the DEMO board: cards in progress (development column), cards in testing and recently done, with each card's reference and title.

positive.description: Create a card following the space's labels
positive.prompt: Create a card in the DEMO space for a bug: Google sign-in fails on Safari.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a card in DEMO with a clear title and a description with problem, solution and tests, applies the Bug label, and replies with the new card reference.
Moves DEMO-1 to the development column (its timer starts), suggests a branch name such as fix/demo-1-..., and summarizes what the card asks for.

positive.prompt: I finished DEMO-1. Comment what changed (I fixed the login redirect) and send it to testing.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a comment to DEMO-1 with what changed and how to test it, then moves the card to the next column after development (the timer pauses).

positive.prompt: Which cards are waiting for testing in DEMO?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists only the cards in the testing columns of DEMO, with reference and title.

negative.prompt: What will the weather be like in São Paulo tomorrow?

negative.description: Creative writing with no project context
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about the sea.
Create a task in Trello to review the contract.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Primeira versão: status do quadro, criar, iniciar e concluir cards, e anexar arquivos, com login pelo Xquad.

en-US.subtitle: Xquad Kanban boards
en-US.description: Work on your Xquad boards by chatting. Start a card and it moves to the development column with its timer running; finish it with a comment on what changed and how to test; create cards that follow the space's labels; see what is in progress, in testing and done; and attach files from your computer. Sign-in is through Xquad (no token), and the agent can only see and change what you can in the app.
